title: Firestore paths, dynamic data, and query/index boundary

surfaces.currentBehavior: Root Firestore rules container; defines the database document scope and shared membership/validation helpers but grants no access itself.
surfaces.notes: The target authorization boundary is captured by individual domain surfaces, grants, RLS, handlers, and Sync Streams.

surfaces.currentBehavior: Allows any Firebase-authenticated user to read health/ping for application connectivity checking.
surfaces.notes: Replace with a target readiness/authorization probe that does not stand in for end-to-end offline health. M2 map reviewed under target-mapping-method.md; target authority is capability-specific and contains no Firebase application adapter.

securityRequirements: Public health returns only coarse service/version status with rate limiting and no tenant, secret, topology or dependency payload
syncRequirements: Connectivity health is distinct from authenticated local/stream readiness and never proves offline data completeness

migration.rule: Migrate no Firebase health document; replace it with target service health plus client `SyncHealthSnapshot` semantics.
reconciliation: Health endpoint/manifest inventory proves only approved fields and distinguishes liveness from dependency/readiness states

tests: Anonymous/rate-limit/no-sensitive-field, dependency degradation and liveness-versus-readiness tests
acceptance: Clients/operators can detect target liveness without reading tenant data or mistaking a ping for synchronized readiness

surfaces.currentBehavior: Starter global user-profile path. A signed-in user may read/write the matching uid path or a document whose existing uid field equals the caller; no shipped app call site was found.

surfaces.currentBehavior: Account root is readable by members. Client create/update/delete is denied; account bootstrap is performed with Admin SDK.

securityRequirements: Existing-row and resulting-row policies derive immutable Account ownership, active membership, Principal and financial/capability grants; service credentials do not bypass handler checks
syncRequirements: Paired RLS and Sync Stream policies filter unauthorized rows/fields/counts before local download and revoke streams/local state according to the session policy

migration.rule: Correlate source tenant rows to immutable target Account/Principal ownership and replace broad Firestore CRUD with capability-specific policies/handlers; preserve denied/invalid variants as migration findings.
reconciliation: Authorization matrix proves exact row/field/count availability for every role/financial capability and source ownership variant across Postgres, Sync, app and MCP

tests: Cross-account, resulting-row ownership, standard/admin/restricted/revoked, service-role handler, Sync payload and migration ownership tests
acceptance: No client receives or mutates data outside its trusted tenant/capability even when payload paths or IDs are forged

surfaces.currentBehavior: Membership record is readable by account members, server-created, non-deletable, and updateable only by owner/admin for role, companyFinancialAccess, allowedFeeCategoryIds, and updatedAt.
surfaces.notes: Membership documents, not custom claims, are current authorization authority. M2 map reviewed under target-mapping-method.md; target authority is capability-specific and contains no Firebase application adapter.

securityRequirements: One verified issuer/subject resolves to a stable Principal; active Account membership and server-owned role/financial grants authorize every request
Account discovery is non-enumerating and no caller-selected UID, Account fallback or service credential substitutes for Principal authority
syncRequirements: Bootstrap streams contain only authorized Account summaries and the caller's membership/capability snapshot; Auth subjects and secrets are not synchronized

migration.rule: Correlate Firebase Auth identities and membership paths to stable Principals/auth identities/account memberships, preserve provider/source IDs for audit and quarantine ambiguous or duplicate identity links.
reconciliation: Every source identity/membership maps once with issuer/subject/Principal/Account/role/financial grants or an explicit blocking quarantine

tests: Identity correlation, Account discovery, cross-account/revoked/expired/non-enumerating access, membership grant and app/MCP parity tests
acceptance: The same Principal/membership authority governs app and MCP without exposing provider IDs or inferring an Account
